data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Ikbal" can be associated with the Hindu concept of Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam, which means 'the world is one family'. This philosophy emphasizes the interconnectedness and oneness of all beings. Ikbal's name is a reminder of the spiritual truth that, despite our differences, we are all one in the underlying essence of the universe. It is a call to embrace love, compassion, and unity in our hearts and actions.
